name: 53726 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53726 (Madison) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53726 (Madison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53726 (Madison) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
